title: Chinese Language Year
summary: One academic year of intensive Mandarin on a Chinese campus — from zero to the level needed for a degree, with HSK preparation built in.
overview: A language year is the most flexible entry point into Chinese higher education. You study on a university campus, build listening, speaking, reading and writing, and test whether the city and the study format suit you before committing to a degree.

University language programs give you student status, access to campus facilities and a clear route toward HSK. Private language centres can be cheaper, but they offer a weaker academic environment and fewer paths into a degree. We choose based on your next step, not on the lowest price.
fitFor: You have no HSK certificate or a level below the degree requirement
You want an academic year in China before starting a bachelor's
You want to experience China before a longer commitment
You are preparing for a Chinese-taught master's or PhD
outcomes: HSK 3–5 depending on your starting level and intensity
Student status, campus housing and university facilities
A realistic understanding of degree requirements
A clear application plan for the next academic level

timeline.text: We agree the city, budget and target level, then shortlist university language programs and compare their hours, class size and progression rules.
Passport, school certificate, translations and supporting documents are prepared; applications are submitted to the chosen programs.
Offer, deposit, JW202 and the X1/X2 student visa. Housing is confirmed at the same time.
Registration, placement test, residence permit, SIM card, insurance and a first-week orientation.

faq.question: Can I start Chinese from zero?
faq.answer: Yes. Most university language programs are designed for beginners and place students in groups after a placement test. A high-school certificate is usually enough for enrolment and the student visa.

faq.question: Does a language year guarantee a place in a degree?
faq.answer: No. The year helps you reach the required HSK level and prepares your documents, but admission to a degree still depends on your certificates, results and the university's own selection process.
